artworks.title: Saint Matthias
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright, wearing a long robe and cloak, with a conical hat. He has a beard and is holding tools like a square and possibly a compass. The man leans on a staff. The background includes a hilly landscape with buildings and mountains. The image is framed with scrollwork.

artworks.title: Saint Erasmus
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure in a stylized woodcut design. The figure has a regal posture, somber expression, and wears a mitre. They are dressed in clerical robes and hold a crosier and another staff. The figure is set within an ornate architectural framework with a halo around the head in the background.

artworks.title: Saint Leonard
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a stylized woodcut print style. The person is slightly leaning to one side and appears to hold a book in one hand. They have a serene expression, with sparse hair on top and wear a long robe. In the other hand, they hold a scroll. A halo surrounds their head. In the background, there are distant mountains and a large church or monastery.

artworks.title: Saint Roch
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut of two individuals depicted from head to toe. The person on the left is standing in a slight profile position, turned towards the right, with curly hair and wings. The individual on the right is facing slightly towards the left, wearing a hat with a halo emitting vertical lines, long hair, and a full beard. Both figures wear detailed, flowing clothing, with the person on the right holding a long staff. Additional objects include what appears to be a book or scroll held by the bearded figure. The background features an ornate frame with elaborate vine and leaf designs.

artworks.title: Saint Wolfgang
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. They are dressed as a religious figure wearing a long robe and a large, elaborate hat resembling a bishop's miter. The person has a serious expression, short hair or is bald, and holds a staff in one hand and a model of a building in the other. The background features hills, buildings, and decorative vines.

artworks.title: Saint Apollonia
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure being confronted by others. The scene is depicted in a style reminiscent of medieval woodcuts, with strong black outlines and intricate details. The central figure appears serene with a halo around the head. Another figure stands on the left, mid-action, while a crowned figure on the right observes. The background shows a landscape with hills and a building or castle. Ornamental designs fill the top corners.

artworks.title: Saint Odilia
artworks.description: The image depicts a person kneeling in a prayer position, with their hands clasped together. The person has a calm facial expression, long hair covered by a large halo, and is wearing long robes. In front of them is a table with a lit candle and a crucifix. To the right, a hooded figure appears to be flying or falling, and below, a bearded man seems to be engulfed in flames. The background shows a brick wall, a window with a diamond lattice pattern, and decorative cloud-like formations.

artworks.title: The Great View of Prague
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic cityscape titled "PRAGA." The scene includes a river cutting through the center, buildings, spires, distant hills, a wall, and a clear sky. An old stone structure is in the foreground on the left. Various buildings and landmarks like "Rattlschin," "Dass Schlos," "Die Kleine Stätte," "Die Alte Statt," "Die Neue Statt," and "Wyszhrad" are visible among the tightly packed structures. The cityscape is detailed with fine linear engravings in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Imperator (Emperor)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man on a throne. He has a long beard and hair, and is wearing a crown with three designs. He wears a robe and holds a spherical object in his left hand, while his right hand rests on the throne's armrest. An eagle or large bird is near his feet. The background includes draped fabric and an intricate border, with the text "IMPERATOR.VIIII" below the image.

artworks.title: Caliope (Calliope)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person playing a long, slender musical instrument. The individual stands with one leg forward in a relaxed pose, holding the instrument close to their mouth. They have long hair, a draped garment, and a focused expression. In the background, there is a landscape with a waterfall, fountain-like structure, and hints of architectural ruins. A tree is positioned behind the person, and the scene is enclosed within a bordered frame.

artworks.title: Urania
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a graceful pose. The person is shown in a three-quarters view, with the body slightly turned to the side, the right foot stepping forward, and the left arm raised holding a large circle. The facial features include closed, almond-shaped eyes, and small, delicate lips, while the hair is long and wavy, cascading down in curls past the shoulders, with a section tied at the top. The person is dressed in a flowing robe that drapes naturally around the body, revealing bare feet peeking out from the hem. In the left hand, they hold a pair of dividers. The background features sloped hills and a small, flowing stream. The image is framed with a patterned border, and the word "VRANIA XII" is inscribed below the figure.

artworks.title: Terpsicore (Terpsichore)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their legs crossed slightly at the ankles, holding a lute in front of their body. The person's face has closed eyes, a serene expression, and a gentle smile. They have long, straight hair and wear a flowing gown, standing barefoot in front of a background of rolling hills, a city skyline, and a starry sky. There is a large circular object near the person's feet, and the image border has a decorative pattern.

artworks.title: Erato
artworks.description: A person is depicted standing in motion, with their body angled forward. They are standing on one leg with the other slightly lifted. Their head is slightly bowed, focusing on an object held in their hands. The person has delicate facial features, a serene expression, long wavy hair, and is wearing a flowing robe. They hold a small spherical object in front of their chest. The background features small hills, vegetation, and structures on the horizon. The scene is enclosed in a circular border.

artworks.title: Polimnia (Polyhymnia)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person holding a small, harp-like instrument. Their facial features are detailed, with high cheekbones, a straight nose, and eyes looking to the side. The person's long, wavy hair falls over their shoulders. They wear a flowing garment with a ribbon at the waist, and their bare feet lightly touch the ground. In the background, there is a hilly landscape with sparse trees and a distant cityscape. The image has a patterned frame.

artworks.title: Talia (Thalia)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure from the head to below the knees in a graceful pose. The person has long hair and a serene expression, wearing a flowing garment while holding a lyre. The background features a simple landscape with trees, enclosed within a patterned border.

artworks.title: Melpomene
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their right foot slightly forward, holding a long horn up to their mouth with both hands. The individual has a concentrated expression, defined features, and long, wavy hair cascading over the shoulders. They are dressed in a long garment tied at the waist with a belt that has a leaf-like embellishment at the front. The setting includes a simple landscape featuring small hills and sparse vegetation. The background has a plain, patterned border framing the scene, with a circular object near the figure's right foot.

artworks.title: Euterpe
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman in profile, facing right. She has soft facial features, closed eyes, long hair, and she is dressed in layered clothing revealing part of her feet. She is holding a double flute to her lips. In the background, there are rolling hills, trees, a distant structure, and a detailed tree behind her. The ground has small tufts of grass, and the image frame is decorated.

artworks.title: Clio
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her left leg slightly bent and her right hand raised open-palmed. Her left hand rests at her side. She has detailed facial features, long curly hair, and wears a flowing garment with additional fabric and ribbons. A swan is at her feet and they stand on water-like waves. In the background, there is a hilly landscape with a structure resembling a tower or castle atop a hill. A decorative border surrounds the entire composition.

artworks.title: Cosmico (Genius of the World)
artworks.description: The image displays an angelic figure in full-length, standing with one leg slightly bent and the other straightforward. They have a youthful face, soft facial features, and wavy shoulder-length hair framing their face. The individual wears a flowing sleeveless garment and has large, feathered wings. In their right hand, they hold a spherical object adorned with stars and a cityscape. The background shows a simple landscape with trees and grass, framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Charita (Charity)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure standing in a frontal position. The person has a serene facial expression with downcast eyes and wavy, shoulder-length hair. They are wearing a long robe cinched at the waist, holding a bag in their right hand from which small round objects appear to be falling. In the surrounding space, there is a simple interior setting with an ornamental border. At the person's feet, there is a bird, potentially a pelican, with wings partially extended. There are no visible items of jewelry on the person. The background is plain, drawing focus to the figure.

artworks.title: Speranza (Hope)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. They face slightly to the left with their hands together in front of their chest. The person's face is lifted upwards, eyes looking towards the upper left corner. They have long hair, draped robes, and bare feet. Near their feet is a bird rising from flames, possibly a phoenix. The background is plain with a light source in the upper left corner. The frame has a linear design, and there is text at the bottom reading "SPERANZA. XXXVIIII."

artworks.title: Fede (Faith)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a person standing upright. The individual is facing slightly left, holding a chalice in their right hand and a staff with a cross on top in their left hand. Their facial features are delicately rendered with soft expressions, and they have shoulder-length, wavy hair. The person is dressed in a long, flowing robe with intricate drapery details, giving an impression of a classical or religious figure. At their feet, a small dog sits attentively, adorned with a collar. The background is plain, and the border consists of a simple, patterned frame.

artworks.title: Luna (Moon)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chariot pulled by a horse, set against a landscaped background. The image shows a figure standing on a chariot that is pulled by a single horse, soaring through the air. The figure is positioned in a dynamic posture, holding a crescent-shaped object in one hand. The bottom section of the drawing displays a serene landscape with hills and water, small boats scattered across the surface of the water, and mountains in the distance. The scene is encompassed by a decorative border, with inscriptions at the bottom. The etching style is precise and detailed, emphasizing the contours and shading that describe the scene vividly.

artworks.title: Mercurio (Mercury)
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure in profile, facing left. The person has a slim build and is mid-stride with one leg slightly bent. They wear a hat with wings, long wavy hair, and a draped garment cinched at the waist. The figure wears calf-high boots and holds a staff with serpents at the top while playing a flute. Nearby, a rooster stands, and above, a winged head is depicted. The background is plain, and the illustration is framed by a rope-like pattern. There are inscriptions beneath the figure's feet.
